description: The file defines a Kotlin class 'PreferenceRepository' that manages app preferences using DataStore and FlowSharedPreferences, including methods to retrieve and set preferences, and handling encrypted strings.

classes.name: PreferenceRepository
classes.description: A repository class to manage application preferences, providing methods to retrieve and modify preferences stored via DataStore and FlowSharedPreferences.

methods.name: getEncryptedString
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a String value associated with the specified key from shared preferences.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all preferences as a Flow of AppPreferences, with error handling for IOExceptions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Inline reified function to get a Flow of Enum preferences of a specific type.

methods.name: putEncryptedStrings
methods.description: Suspended function to set multiple encrypted string preferences simultaneously.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Suspended generic function to set a specific enum preference.
